hypotheses.contradicted_by: any parameter-neutral gated probe closing >= 50% of the deficit
hypotheses.name: gating mechanism failure
hypotheses.prediction: no parameter-neutral change to the gated model's training closes the deficit
hypotheses.statement: gated recurrence is structurally unable to integrate coarse observations at this size

hypotheses.contradicted_by: a no-switch deficit >= 50% of the switching deficit
hypotheses.name: slow recovery after regime switches
hypotheses.prediction: the deficit is concentrated after switches and vanishes without switches
hypotheses.statement: the gated model re-estimates speed slowly after an unannounced switch

hypotheses.contradicted_by: gate saturation fraction at or below 20%
hypotheses.name: pathological gate saturation
hypotheses.prediction: more than 20% of gate values beyond 0.01/0.99 on coarse streams
hypotheses.statement: keep/reset gates saturate at 0 or 1 and block learning

hypotheses.contradicted_by: the no-error-input ablation closing < 50% or worsening the deficit
hypotheses.name: gate / previous-error-input interaction
hypotheses.prediction: removing input 3 closes >= 50% of the deficit
hypotheses.statement: the large, quantized previous-error input disrupts the gated state

hypotheses.name: optimization / learning rate
hypotheses.prediction: the gated model at lr 0.01 closes >= 50%; the ungated model at 0.03 loses >= 50% of its lead
hypotheses.statement: the gated model's higher selected learning rate (0.03 vs 0.01) inflates SGD noise on quantized targets

hypotheses.contradicted_by: the 16-unit ungated RNN keeping > 50% of the lead
hypotheses.name: hidden width at equal budget
hypotheses.prediction: a 16-unit ungated RNN loses >= 50% of the ungated lead
hypotheses.statement: 28 ungated units simply hold more state than 16 gated units

hypotheses.name: initialization sensitivity
hypotheses.prediction: initializations disagree on the sign of the deficit
hypotheses.statement: a few unlucky initializations carry the deficit

hypotheses.name: TBPTT / credit assignment
hypotheses.prediction: a 16-step horizon closes >= 50% of the deficit
hypotheses.statement: a 4-step truncation prevents learning a multi-step integrator

hypotheses.name: event-dominated mean
hypotheses.prediction: >= 50% of the deficit falls within 5 steps after a switch
hypotheses.statement: a small set of event steps (switch neighbourhoods) dominates the deficit

hypotheses.contradicted_by: a parameter-neutral gated probe closing >= 50% while H6 is not supported
hypotheses.name: legitimate width tradeoff; no model change warranted
hypotheses.prediction: H6 supported and no parameter-neutral gated probe closes >= 50%
hypotheses.statement: the ungated control's 28 units legitimately beat 16 gated units on this family

hypotheses.contradicted_by: >= 75% of fresh streams showing the deficit
hypotheses.name: ordinary statistical tail
hypotheses.prediction: fewer than 75% of fresh diagnostic streams show the deficit
hypotheses.statement: the deficit is a few noisy streams, not a mechanism

hypotheses.name: short keep-gate memory horizon
hypotheses.prediction: mean keep gate near 0.5, the champion no better than its state-reset ablation, and a keep-bias initialization closing >= 50% of the deficit
hypotheses.statement: with zero-initialized keep-gate biases the gated state halves every step, so it cannot average over the many coarse transitions needed to resolve speed; the model then behaves like its own stateless ablation
